package_accounting.transient_estimate_note: Estimate adds serialized pre-action row and one float32 3 x 3 candidate (36 bytes) to the preceding package boundary; in-flight package measurements already include serialized pending feedback. This is not a package-cap breach calculation.
package_accounting.resume_note: Decision-boundary checkpoints have no pending feedback and omit external simulator state; they do not establish exact arbitrary-step environment resumption.
